definitions.week: ISO-8601 week in UTC, Monday 00:00:00.000 to Sunday 23:59:59.999. `end` is the last millisecond of the week.
definitions.exclusions: Users with role admin, disabled users (disable = 1), users an admin marked as test accounts in /admin/users (isTestAccount = true), and test/QA accounts on reserved example/.test/.invalid/.localhost email domains or in a documented constant list of company-owned addresses are never counted.
definitions.signups: Non-excluded users whose createdAt falls in the week.
definitions.signedIn: Signups of the week with at least one successful sign-in (login_success audit event, Google sign-ins included) within 7 days of signup.
definitions.material: Signups of the week who, within 7 days of signup, authored a quiz, submitted an attempt on a quiz they did not author, or had a succeeded upload (Path B). Every activated signup is material.
definitions.startedQuiz: Signups of the week who, within 7 days of signup, submitted a quiz attempt or had an adaptive completion (every activated signup), or have an unsubmitted quiz with at least one answer saved after signup (in-progress quizzes keep only their last update time). activated <= startedQuiz <= signups.
definitions.activated: Signups of the week with at least one completed (submitted) quiz attempt or adaptive completion within 7 days of signup. Each learner is counted once.
definitions.activatedBy: Split of activated by path within the 7-day window: quiz (attempt only), adaptive (adaptive completion only), both. quiz + adaptive + both = activated. claimedGuest is a subset of activated, not a fourth path: activated signups with a qualifying attempt made as a guest and claimed into the account. claimedGuestDraft is a subset of claimedGuest: that attempt was on a quiz the guest made from their own PDF, claimed with the quiz.
definitions.weeklyActivatedLearners: Distinct non-excluded users whose first ever completion, the earlier of their first completed attempt and their first adaptive completion, fell in the week, whatever their signup week. North-star series.
definitions.weeklyActivatedBy: Split of weeklyActivatedLearners by the path that gave the first ever completion: quiz, adaptive, or both when the first attempt and the first adaptive completion fall in the same week.
definitions.adaptiveCompletion: Path B: every 5th answered adaptive exercise (an answer was recorded) on one uploaded document, timed at that exercise. A learner with fewer than 5 answers on every document has none.
definitions.succeededUpload: Path B: an adaptive document-processing job that reached completed, timed at its completion. Failed, cancelled and in-flight jobs do not count.
definitions.w1Retained: Activated signups of the week who also completed a quiz attempt or an adaptive completion on days 7-13 after signup. null until the youngest signup of the week is 14 days old.
definitions.w1RetentionRate: w1Retained / activated, rounded to 4 decimals; null when either is null or 0.
definitions.returnedWeek1: Signups of the week with a sign-in, quiz attempt or adaptive completion on a later calendar day in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh than their signup day, and less than 7 days after signup. Activation is not required. null until 7 days after the end of the week. Weeks themselves stay UTC ISO weeks.
definitions.complete: true once every number in the row is final: 14 days after the end of the week. The current week and the two before it are partial.
definitions.sources: sources.adaptive is ok when the Path B events were read from the API, unavailable when that read failed or took over 2 s: every number is then quiz-only, and the response is not cached.
definitions.limitations: Unsubmitted in-progress quiz attempts are not counted as material. A learner whose session is still live comes back without signing in again, so they count in returnedWeek1 only if they also attempt or complete. Adaptive learners with 1-4 answers and no completion are not visible to the web (Path B reports completions only), so they are missing from startedQuiz. Sign-in events are kept 180 days.
definitions.activationEmail: One-time activation nudge emails (RIN-999), bucketed by the UTC ISO week they were sent in (the worker slot of the delivery the provider accepted), not by signup week. sent: delivered nudges of non-excluded learners. clicked: sends whose CTA click was recorded (0 until click tracking ships). activatedWithin7d: sends followed by a completed quiz attempt or adaptive completion in [send, send + 7 days); final 7 days after the week ends. byTrigger splits each count by what enqueued the email: 24h (the sweep 24 h after signup) or backfill; the totals are their sums.
definitions.activatedByEntry: Split of activated by the entry point of the first qualifying attempt (the earliest completed quiz attempt within 7 days of signup), as the quiz link carried it (?entry=, stored on the attempt since RIN-1256): blog, landing (homepage play-first), post_signin_starter, activation_email, hub (a topic hub card, since RIN-1417; the topic slug of the hub is stored on the attempt as topic). none: no tracked entry, which covers attempts before RIN-1256, untracked links, and learners activated by an adaptive completion only. The six add up to activated. A claimed guest attempt keeps its entry.
definitions.blogPosts: Top 10 public blog post slugs (?post=, with entry=blog) by activated signups of the week whose first qualifying attempt came from that post, most first, ties by slug. A blog entry without a valid post counts in activatedByEntry.blog only.
